questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the maximum speed you may drive. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows laws drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign alerts you that wet pavement may be slippery and harder to control. Drive extra carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pavement is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or direction changes, and stay farther away from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is coming. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic moves on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop if other traffic is in the intersection or crossing. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop or slow down for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has low clearance overhead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and enforce rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a side road is coming up. Watch for traffic entering from that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and enforce rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid an upcoming hazard.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or for driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: When an "Exit only" sign appears above your lane, that lane becomes an exit ramp and does not continue through the interchange. You must either change lanes to continue on the freeway or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On horizontal traffic signals, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.
